qa_pairs.question: Douyin e - commerce plans to improve the sales performance of autumn and winter clothing. Which of the following strategic suggestions is the most reasonable, can effectively capture market opportunities and improve the input - output efficiency?

answer.A: Reduce the investment in the graphic channel because its consumer usage rate is relatively low; re - allocate the released resources to the live - streaming and short - video channels, and focus on categories with stable growth (such as sports down jackets) to optimize the overall marketing efficiency.
answer.B: Increase the overall advertising budget and optimize the brand image to enhance consumers' trust and loyalty, thereby indirectly promoting sales growth.
answer.C: Increase the resource investment in the short - video channel, especially for displaying categories with a relatively fast growth rate (such as trail running shoes and soft shell clothing). Use the visual appeal of short videos to enhance consumers' interest; combine with the live - streaming room for diversion to form a channel synergy effect and expand the coverage.
answer.D: Give priority to promoting categories with the lowest growth rate (such as sports polo shirts with a growth rate of 38%) to avoid market bubbles and ensure stable returns, rather than chasing high - growth but high - risk categories.
answer.E: Invest the main resources in the graphic channel. Although it accounts for a low proportion (16%), it may represent an emerging trend. Consumers may turn to a quieter graphic experience after getting tired of live - streaming.
answer.F: Give priority to concentrating the marketing budget on the live - streaming room channel because it is the main way for consumers to make purchases; at the same time, focus on promoting categories with extremely high growth rates in transaction amount (such as outdoor functional socks and shark leggings) in the live - streaming room to take advantage of the explosive growth potential of these categories.
answer.G: Invest in cross - platform marketing (such as Weibo and WeChat) to expand the brand coverage and attract more potential consumers.
